evidence.computation: Exact Mendelian probabilities and dominant-first phenotype ratios for one through six distinct loci. The kernel composes independent-locus probabilities multiplicatively and checks Hardy-Weinberg frequency bounds.
assumptions: Complete dominance and independent assortment; repeated locus letters are not separate independent loci.
Hardy-Weinberg calculations assume the equilibrium model and the requested allele/phenotype meaning.
The model describes a hypothetical cross, not a prediction establishing biological independence in a real organism.
untrusted: English recognition, locus identity and alignment, choice of model, decimal parsing and JSON framing.

evidence.computation: Exact Lincoln-Petersen/Chapman estimates from unique whole count roles; density converts the supplied area to the requested unit; closed-cohort survival distinguishes the second observation period from the cumulative two-period total.
assumptions: Counts are nonnegative whole observed animals; conflicting count roles or more than two capture samples are not combined into a two-sample estimate.
Mark-recapture retains its positive-overlap coverage and ecological sampling assumptions; no claim that arithmetic establishes a closed population or equal catchability.
Density area units are hectares, acres, square kilometers or square miles; international acre and mile conversions are exact. One stated population and one stated area are required.
Two-period survival follows one closed cohort without entrants or replacement. The second-period denominator is the surviving first endpoint; cumulative survival uses the original count.
A multi-year observed total does not identify an annual survival or mortality rate without an additional model. Conditional survival for an empty cohort is undefined.
untrusted: English count/period-role binding, observation completeness, supplied measurements, unit interpretation, exact numeric tokenization and framing.

evidence.computation: Normalize explicit template/coding strand and 5-prime/3-prime direction; select positive reading frame1–3 inside the extracted kernel; translate complete remaining codons under the standard genetic code and stop at the first stop codon. Protein length counts resulting amino acids.
assumptions: Frame is relative to the normalized 5-prime coding sequence; absence of an explicit frame preserves frame 1.
Only the standard genetic code is supported; negative/six-frame search, open-reading-frame discovery and terminal partial-codon translation are outside this model.
Strand role/direction must be unambiguous. Mixed DNA/RNA bases are rejected on the original sequence before selecting a frame.
untrusted: English sequence extraction, frame/strand/direction binding, supplied model applicability, source codon table, exact numeric lexer and framing.

evidence.computation: CFU equals colonies divided by dilution times plated volume. The kernel enforces nonnegative colony counts, dilution in (0,1], positive volume and nonnegative concentration. Binary-fission trajectories, generation counts and generation times use exact time conversions; requested generation-time units are retained. Serial dilutions compose equal positive integer factors for a whole nonnegative step count.
assumptions: Colony count and plated volume are explicitly supplied and uniquely assigned; units are converted to mL.
The concentration estimator uses the supplied dilution and plate count without certifying sampling validity.

Binary fission has constant positive doubling time and nonnegative initial population/forward elapsed time; inferred positive generation time requires positive starting population, a larger final population and positive elapsed time.
Time inputs support seconds, minutes, hours and days. Generation-time output uses the explicitly requested supported unit, defaulting to minutes only when none is requested.
Serial dilution uses equal factors and complete whole step counts; explicit heterogeneous dilution sequences remain unsupported.
untrusted: Shared exact numeric tokenization, English quantity-role binding, physical observations and framing.

evidence.computation: Certified continuous exponential and logistic population trajectories, and instantaneous rate at a requested time. The rate uses N(t), not the initial N0; interval error is inherited by both quantities.
assumptions: Population and elapsed time are nonnegative; logistic carrying capacity is positive.

Exponential intrinsic rate may be signed. Forward logistic trajectories permit signed rates at or below capacity; above capacity a negative intrinsic rate is excluded because finite-time divergence can occur.
Zero initial population is the zero equilibrium. Parameter declarations and requested target are separate roles; rate and time must use compatible units.
untrusted: English quantity roles, target clause and unit interpretation; shared exact numeric parsing and framing.

evidence.computation: Basal area sums stated diameter-class cross sections times trees per acre; metric stands retain their population density and output area. Doyle/Smalian log volume and clinometer height preserve complete signed dimensions with exact length-unit conversion.
assumptions: Every supplied diameter class denotes nonoverlapping trees at its stated density. A representative single diameter denotes uniform diameter or quadratic mean diameter; an explicit arithmetic mean alone cannot establish exact area.
Basal area in square feet uses the stated rounded0.005454 inch coefficient; metric area uses pi. Doyle uses small-end diameter greater than4inches and nonnegative length.
Clinometer distance is horizontal and angle is to the top; eye height has its own unit. Sloping ground or multiple-angle models remain unsupported.
Dimensions and counts are nonnegative; spacing and horizontal viewing distance are positive.
untrusted: English role binding, supplied class coverage, unit interpretation, model applicability, shared exact numeric lexer and framing.
